source.note: Plan row 19 names the poly.pizza Quaternius rat (behind a Cloudflare challenge); it comes from the same author's Easy Animated Enemy Pack (Jan 2019) on itch.io, which carries the six Rat_* clips. The itch page states CC0; the zip ships no licence file. Real size: 0.14 m at rest (top of the back), which makes the head and body about 24 cm and the tail about 21 cm, a large brown rat. The source models no eyes (two materials, Grey coat and Pink ears, nose, paws and tail; the clay render shows a blank face), so the face reads by its snout, pink nose and ears. Colours on the indigo script: a night-blue coat (sky) shading to near-black (hair) with threshold 0 so the shade sits under the belly and legs, pink skin shading to accent red (threshold -0.2). Ground: Rat_Run (hind toes up to 15 mm under in the gallop), Rat_Jump (10 mm), Rat_Attack (5 mm) and Rat_Death (20 mm once it lies on its side) are clamped; Rat_Idle and Rat_Walk stay planted.
